tiles.prompt: A 3 by 3 grid of nine square game block textures, each one filling its own square cell completely edge to edge, the cells separated by thin straight pure black gutters, seen flat-on like Minecraft block faces but in the gritty mid-1990s Duke Nukem 3D texture style, painterly-photographic and slightly pixelated: 1) an olive-green military ammo crate with stencilled lettering and brass cartridges; 2) a red TNT crate face with bundled dynamite sticks; 3) the top of a yellow nuclear waste drum with a black radiation trefoil; 4) old red city bricks with grime; 5) a cluster of rusty industrial pipes and valves; 6) diagonal yellow and black hazard stripes on dented steel; 7) a blue glowing atomic health orb set in a dark metal panel; 8) a bubbling bright green toxic slime pool; 9) a grey steel air vent grille with rivets. No text labels, no border around the whole image, no shadows between cells.

boxart.prompt: Mid-1990s PC game box cover painting, dramatic airbrushed style, night. The open back of a white box truck parked crooked in a grimy back yard under a single orange sodium wall lamp, its rear doors swung wide. Inside, among cardboard moving boxes and dust sheets, a big muscular man lies passed out on his back, seen from his boots: only his huge scuffed combat boots, his legs in camo trousers and one muscular arm flopped over the tailgate are visible, his face hidden in shadow. Around him the debris of a wild night: party streamers, a crushed party hat, empty beer cans, an empty tequila bottle rolling on the tailgate, a pink feather boa, a single red stiletto shoe, scattered arcade tokens. In the background, the dark back wall of a building with a glowing green EXIT sign over a propped-open fire door. The top third of the picture is dark night sky with clouds, left empty for a title. No text, no logos, no lettering anywhere.
